name: Metalia Beach
description: A calm rocky inlet south of Limenaria — ideal first swim stop with excellent snorkelling over iron-ore formations.

name: Tripiti Cave
description: One of Thassos' signature boat stops — a dramatic sea cave and turquoise shallows on the south-west coast.

name: Pefkari Beach
description: Shallow sandy water perfect for families — moor offshore and swim into a relaxed south-coast beach.

name: Potos Harbor
description: Moor nearby and stroll ashore for fresh seafood, cafés, and the lively south-coast village atmosphere.

name: Aliki Ancient Quarry
description: Circle 2,000-year-old marble workings and snorkel submerged ruins in crystal-clear south-east water.

name: Golden Beach
description: Thassos' most iconic stretch — anchor offshore at Chrisi Akti and swim into paradise on the east coast.

name: Marble Beach
description: Dramatic marble scree meets deep Aegean blue on the north shore — best approached early before the breeze picks up.

name: Vathi Bay
description: A quiet pine-fringed bay on the north-east coast — drop anchor for golden-hour swims away from the main beach crowds.
